en.title: Do They Belong?
en.description:
Given a triangle formed by three vertices and the points p and q. Return 0 for a degenerate triangle; otherwise return 1, 2, 3, or 4 depending on whether p and q lie inside the triangle or on its boundary.

This site's input protocol and the explicitly stated supplementary ranges are compiled by CSWork and do not pose as the original OA rules.
en.input: A single line containing x1 y1 x2 y2 x3 y3 xp yp xq yq in order; all coordinates are integers in 0..2000.
en.output: Return 0..4 according to the cases in the statement: 1 = only p is inside/on the boundary, 2 = only q is inside/on the boundary, 3 = both points are, 4 = neither point is.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Use the signed-area cross product to check that the triangle is non-degenerate, then check whether the cross-product signs of the point against the three edges agree. A zero cross product lets the point lie on the boundary.
